title: How I hacked a hardware crypto wallet and recovered $2 million
summary: Joe Grand recounts being hired to hack a Trezor One hardware wallet and recover $2 million of cryptocurrency. He describes three months of experimentation, voltage glitching, failures and high-stakes attempts with only one chance to get it right.
why: Recommended as a gripping real-world hardware hacking story and a showcase of Joe Grand's skill.

quote.text: a cool video about someone hacking a Trezor One. Very enjoyable watch.
